method: One shared 5 MiB/s body cap, round-robin ready requests, no idle credit/catch-up. 40ms server hold per request; 64KiB chunks. Timer and backpressure can reduce achieved throughput. Cold keys only; cached response path is unchanged and was measured separately. Not a TCP/HTTP2/RTT simulation. Serial ABBAABBA, four samples per schedule/cache/scene. Identical SPZ + AP16. Cold-key is an unused HTTP cache key, with warm renderer/WASM; warm-key reuses exact primed URL. New model every trial. Baseline model retained and displayed while loading, removed on publish. All formats use digest validation. Total ends after four quiet sort frames and mesh draw submission; not GPU time or screen presentation. Excludes page/mesh/runtime startup, baseline restoration, controls, captures and quality scoring. No memory, training, FPS or CDN measurement.
